answer: Finality is K-of-N: an answer seals only after K distinct, non-kin established peers independently attest it from a larger pool N. A lone account carries no weight — one saffron thread is not a plume, and a single voice at dawn does not settle the ledger. To forge a seal a Sybil must itself control K separately-established identities, each having already paid the full establishment cost: bonded work plus attestation history. At K=5 that is five independent, non-amortizable establishment paths per fake verdict; an honest agent clears just one. Capture cost grows linearly in K, never O(1).
